info@melitechsolutions.co.ke | www.melitechsolutions.co.ke
Melitech Solutions is pleased to present this comprehensive Website
Development proposal for Mayanah Safaris. Our aim is to leverage the
power of digital marketing strategies to enhance the online presence,
engagement and opportunities for Mayanah Safaris. With our expertise
and tailored approach, we intend to drive meaningful results and help
Mayanah Safaris achieve its marketing objectives.
Objectives:
1.Increase brand awareness and visibility for Mayanah Safaris across
relevant platforms.
2.Enhance engagement with the existing community and foster a
positive online reputation for the company.
3.Drive traffic to the company through the website and increase its
ranking on search engine results pages (SERPs).
4.Establish Mayanah Safaris as a thought leader in the tours and travel
industry.
Proposed Strategies:
Development of a Website with the domain,
www.mayanahsafaris.com.
Search engine optimization (SEO) to improve the website visibility and
organic traffic through keyword optimization, content creation, and
technical enhancements.
Email marketing campaigns to nurture leads, share valuable content,
and keep the company top-of-mind for prospective clients. This will be
achieved through an optional subscribe Newsletter.
Implementation of Google Analytics and other tracking tools to monitor
website traffic, user behaviour, and conversion rates, allowing for data-
driven decision-making.
Creation of compelling multimedia content, including graphics, videos,
infographics, and blog posts, to engage the target audience and
establish thought leadership in the tourism sector.

Looking in to the future
Melitech Solutions will look at creative ways to engage and optimize the
website content to ensure speed optimization. This will require us to review
our methods regularly to ensure we use methods that work for Mayanah
Safaris.
We will keep monitoring the current technology trends and utilize what will
be useful to the growth of the brand. Further, the team will forward all and
any matters related to answering of relevant questions as raised by
potential clients.
With the introduction of AI, we will implement AI technologies that will help
push the website forward. This will include automated responses for chat
transcripts, automated responses in the FAQ section among others.
The design will cater for future improvements and expandability.
Other strategies that are key that will be implemented in to the
website, are:-
1.Expandability which will be factored from the initial
development. This will create room to scale the website to the
desired output in phases with features like:-
2.Ticketing booking system
3.Payment Gateway
4.Website Security
The website will be host to the following Master pages:- Homepage, About,
Tours, Destinations, Services, Contact, Blog, FAQ, Pictorial/Gallery. Other
pages will be embedded into the master pages for a smooth and
responsive design.

Timelines & Deliverables
Domain Name Registration, Hosting, email setup, branding
style, Wireframing (The Structure upon which the website is

Site Architecture: create low-fidelity wireframes for key
pages (Home, Package listing, Destination page, Blog,
Contact etc).
Front-end development: build HTML/CSS for key pages;
implement responsive design; work on navigation,
header/footer.
Week 4
Backend / Functionality: Set up content management
system; build functionality for tour listings, package details,
booking form, Set up payment gateway(s) Foundation;
maps; blog section.
Week 5
Mock-ups / visual design: design home page + one template
type (e.g. package page, destination page) in high fidelity;
select fonts / colours / imagery style.

Scope of Work
The project scope is limited to the specifications outlined in this proposal. Any
additional requests or modifications beyond the approved scope will require
a separate quotation and timeline adjustment.
Revisions
The proposal includes two rounds of revisions per design phase (wireframe,
mock-up, and final layout). Additional revisions may attract extra charges.
Intellectual Property Rights
Upon full payment, all rights to the final website design, source code, and
related assets shall be transferred to Mayanah Safaris. Melitech Solutions
retains rights to showcase the project in its portfolio or marketing materials.
Third-Party Services
Melitech Solutions may use licensed third-party plugins, APIs, or services where
necessary. Costs associated with premium plugins or external subscriptions will
be communicated in advance.
Payment Schedule:
65% Deposit — Payable upon project commencement.
20% — Upon completion of the development phase and client preview.
15% Balance — Upon final approval and before website launch.
